convert_finetune_checkpoint_to_release: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by copying backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
run_convert_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI script to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint to release format using --fine-tune-checkpoint and --output-release-checkpoint arguments
convert_finetune_yaml_config: convert a fine-tuned YAML config to release format by removing finetune_config and copying backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint into the fine-tuned checkpoint
summarize_checkpoint_conversion_logic: summarize the checkpoint conversion logic that loads both fine-tuned and starting checkpoints, merges model configs, and removes finetune_config before saving
